title: Uneasiness
summary: UNE'ASINESS, noun 1. A moderate degree of pain; restlessness; want of ease; disquiet. 2. Unquietness of mind; moderate anxiety or perturbation; disquietude. 3. That which makes uneasy or gives trouble

inlines.v: UNE'ASINESS, noun 1. A moderate degree of pain; restlessness; want of ease; disquiet. 2. Unquietness of mind; moderate anxiety or perturbation; disquietude. 3. That which makes uneasy or gives trouble; ruggedness; as the uneasiness of the road. [Unusual.]
